title: GO:0000018 · Random: all configurations with intervals
caption: All 49 configurations on the random test set of GO:0000018, ranked by MCC, with 95% stratified bootstrap intervals. 46 of 49 intervals exclude zero. The median interval width is 0.25 (range 0.17–0.34), so neighbouring ranks are usually statistically indistinguishable. Colours mark the descriptor.
